x: Charlie was given a nasty turn when Betty almost ran over half the 'A' team; later it was hinted that our over-whelming victory was perhaps due to Betty's lethal driving as she set about the rest of the field.
We are all poorer by his passing, but enriched by knowing him and enjoying his company over the years and our sympathy to his wife Betty and his two daughters in their great loss.

Charlie had a fall just a year ago and doesn't get out as regularly as he used to but both he and Betty are well. Win Shepherd too recalls a Belgrave trip on the Continent - to the Rome Olympics of 1960.
